name: patrika
description: Patrika — reliable email campaign scheduler (BullMQ + Redis + Postgres) with a Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api -w backend" "npm run dev:worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
